rule: Construct explicit order and omission controls; compose existing model certificates
meaning: Use the Mathlib powerset inclusion order and real order separately, inject constants/singletons to witness both infinite carriers, and refute each coordinate bound by a+1. Exhibit a proper region with no priority edge; midpoint extends each open-interval degree; disjoint singleton regions witness restricted incomparable maxima.
